note: D21: *não me repreendais*, overruling the agent's *acuseis* at the opening of two Penitential Psalms (= 37:2). Every living witness says rebuke; the cost is that *repreender* also serves *increpáre*.

*no inferno*, the Latin's word (D22, not settled): the blind reader heard the hell of the damned first. Matos Soares 1932 paraphrases *na habitação dos mortos*; *nos infernos*, *na mansão dos mortos* are options.
*Cansei-me gemendo*: the stylist faulted *no meu gemido*, but his *Cansei-me de gemer* is heard as "fed up with groaning", so a third wording was made. No stylist has read it.
*pelo furor* names no owner, as the Latin; the blind reader heard the speaker's own rage first, the Lord's second, the enemies' third. Kept open on purpose.
